operational_changes: Expired housekeeping state is physically deleted on scheduled UTC minute zero rather than every minute; a missed/failed cleanup waits for a later hourly opportunity.

No-claim daily report result now has payload:null; aggregation failures release the owned report lease before propagating the failure.
Confirmed keyed-only migration state is authoritative: subsequent out-of-contract raw-hook writes are not automatically reconverted. Legacy/dual conversion and finalization barriers remain.
limits: These fixture row savings are not a measured percentage reduction of production/account D1 usage.
